subtitle: From the Jade Gates to Bactria: An Exiled People on the Long Road West

panels.shot: epic wide shot, low angle, showing a great caravan against snow-capped ranges
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu stands on a rise above an endless line of riders, wagons and herds moving westward under a vast sky of mountains and clouds.

dialogue.text: Across a thousand mountains the Greater Yuezhi ride, driven from the eastern grasslands toward a new world in Bactria.

i18n.hi: हज़ार पहाड़ों के पार महा यूएझी घुड़सवार दौड़ते हैं, पूर्वी घासभूमि से हाँके गए, बाक्ट्रिया की नई दुनिया की ओर।

panels.shot: slow push-in from wide grassland to mid-shot on the Yabghu
panels.action: On broad Gansu grasslands, Greater Yuezhi Yabghu sits astride a horse, watching flocks and felt tents under the clear steppe sky, wind tugging his cloak.

dialogue.text: In the age when Han power was young, the Greater Yuezhi grazed their herds on the grasslands of Gansu, a nomad people between deserts and mountains.

i18n.hi: जब हान ताकत अभी जवान थी, महा यूएझी गांसू की घासभूमि पर चरते थे, रेगिस्तान–पहाड़ों के बीच के खानाबदोश।

panels.shot: high-contrast mid-shot, Yabghu in council circle at dusk
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu sits among elders around a low fire, discussing horses and raids, their silhouettes sharp against the dimming steppe horizon.

dialogue.text: They knew the bow and the horse, traded with Chinese commanderies, and watched warily as the Xiongnu confederation rose like a storm to the north.

i18n.hi: उनके पास धनुष–घोड़ा था, चीनी कमांडरियों से सौदा करते थे, और उत्तर में तूफ़ान बन उठते श्योंगनु संघ को तिरी–तिरी देखते रहते थे।

panels.shot: dramatic wide shot of battle lines across open steppe
panels.action: Armored Xiongnu riders sweep in from the distance, kicking up dust, while Greater Yuezhi Yabghu rallies his riders, faces grim, horses rearing on the plain.

dialogue.text: Around 176 BCE, Xiongnu power crashed down upon them. On the open steppe, Yuezhi resistance broke before the larger confederation.

i18n.hi: लगभग 176 ईसा पूर्व, श्योंगनु की शक्ति उन पर टूट पड़ी। खुली स्टेप पर, यूएझी की मज़ाहमत बड़ी संघ के सामने टूट गई।

panels.shot: somber mid-shot, Yabghu half-turned away from the battlefield
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu looks back at distant smoke over the grasslands, then forward toward rugged hills, his hand tightening on the reins.

dialogue.text: Chinese chroniclers later spoke of cruel trophies and broken tribes. What endures is clear: the Yuezhi heartland was shattered, and their leaders chose exile over submission.

i18n.hi: चीनी इतिहासकारों ने बाद में क्रूर निशानों और टूटी कौमों का ज़िक्र किया। जो साफ़ रहा: यूएझी का दिल–इलाका चकनाचूर हो गया, और उनके सरदारों ने ग़ुलामी से बेहतर जला–वतन चुना।

panels.shot: wide caravan shot threading into mountain passes
panels.action: The Yabghu rides at the head of a long column of wagons and mounted families, entering a rocky pass, children and elders bundled against the chill.

dialogue.speaker: the_greater_yuezhi
dialogue.text: We leave our old pastures, but we do not leave our name.

i18n.hi: हम पुराने चरागाह छोड़ते हैं, अपना नाम नहीं छोड़ते।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view over frozen river and snowy peaks
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu urges his horse across a partially frozen river, while the caravan crosses carefully behind, snow-dusted peaks looming on both sides.

dialogue.text: Driven from Gansu, they moved northwest, toward the Ili region. It was not a single march, but years of winter crossings, lost herds, and hard bargains for passage.

i18n.hi: गांसू से निकाले गए, वे उत्तर–पश्चिम इलि की तरफ़ बढ़े। यह एक ही मार्च नहीं था, बल्कि बरसों की सर्द पारियाँ, खोए मवेशी और राह के लिए कड़े सौदे।

panels.shot: tense mid-shot, standoff between two mounted groups
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu faces Saka chiefs across a narrow valley, both groups mounted, hands near bows, herds grazing uneasily between them.

dialogue.text: In the Ili valley they pressed against other nomads. Saka groups gave way or moved aside, pushed south and west in turn by the refugee Yuezhi host.

i18n.hi: इलि घाटी में वे दूसरे खानाबदोशों से भिड़े। साका टोले हटे या साइड हुए, खुद भी शरणार्थी यूएझी हुजूम से धकेलकर दक्षिण–पश्चिम की ओर निकल गए।

panels.shot: expansive wide, caravan descending to fertile plains
panels.action: The Yabghu leads the caravan down from rocky hills onto greener plains, rivers and distant orchards hinting at the settled lands of Sogdia ahead.

dialogue.text: Steppe gave way to river valleys. Through Sogdia, past traders’ towns and farmed fields, the Yuezhi trace a long arc toward the old Hellenistic realm of Bactria.

i18n.hi: स्टेप की जगह अब नदी घाटियाँ थीं। सोग्दिया से गुजरते, सौदागर कस्बों और खेती वाली ज़मीनों के पार, यूएझी एक लंबा चाप खींचते हुए पुराने हेलेनिस्टिक बाक्ट्रिया की ओर मुड़े।

panels.shot: wide shot showing ruined city walls and approaching riders
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu surveys weathered walls and half-abandoned towers of a Bactrian town, Greek-style columns broken, irrigation canals still gleaming.

dialogue.text: By the mid-second century BCE, the Greco-Bactrian kingdom was weakened by internal strife and Saka pressure. Into this fractured land the Yuezhi arrived.

i18n.hi: दूसरी सदी ईसा पूर्व के बीच तक, यूनानी–बाक्ट्रियाई राज कमजोर था — अंदरूनी झगड़े और साका दबाव से। इसी बिखरी ज़मीन में यूएझी पहुँचे।

panels.shot: low-angle mid-shot, Yabghu touching cultivated soil
panels.action: The Yabghu dismounts and kneels, lifting a handful of dark earth from a field near Bactrian canals, his warriors watching curiously from the road.

dialogue.text: Here were cities, coins, and irrigation canals. A nomad people, hardened by flight, now chose to root themselves in Bactrian soil and take its wealth as their own.

i18n.hi: यहाँ शहर थे, सिक्के थे, नहरें थीं। उड़ते–फिरते लोग, जो भागते–भागते सख़्त हो चुके थे, अब बाक्ट्रिया की मिट्टी में जड़ें जमाने और उसकी दौलत अपना बनाने को तैयार थे।

panels.shot: mid-shot inside a tent, Yabghu with five chiefs around a map
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu sits at the center of a felt tent, with four other clan leaders around a spread-out hide map marked with rivers and towns.

dialogue.text: Chinese envoy Zhang Qian, arriving later, would find them settled and prosperous, their power divided among five yabghus, each guarding a portion of northern Bactria.

i18n.hi: चीनी दूत झांग चिएन बाद में आया, तो उन्हें बस गए, समृद्ध पाया — उनकी ताकत पाँच याबगूओं में बाँटी थी, हर एक उत्तरी बाक्ट्रिया के एक हिस्से की रखवाली करता।

panels.shot: focused mid-shot on Yabghu indicating one clan on the map
panels.action: The Yabghu points to a symbol on the hide map, representing the clan of Guishuang, while a younger chief listens intently, hands clasped.

dialogue.text: Among these five was Guishuang, a clan that would one day rise above its peers and become known to history as the Kushans.

i18n.hi: इन पाँच में से ही गुइश्वांग नाम का कुल था, जो एक दिन सबके ऊपर उठकर इतिहास में कुषाण के नाम से मशहूर होगा।

panels.shot: wide townscape shot, mixing tents, mud-brick houses and distant stupas
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu rides through a bustling Bactrian settlement where nomad tents stand beside mud-brick houses, and a distant Buddhist stupa rises on a hill.

dialogue.text: Under Yuezhi rule, horsemen and farmers shared the same valleys. Their world touched Iranian cults, Hellenistic coins, early Buddhist shrines, and the caravan routes of the Silk Road.

i18n.hi: यूएझी हुकूमत में घुड़सवार और किसान एक ही घाटियों में रहते थे। उनकी दुनिया ईरानी मज़हबों, हेलेनिस्टिक सिक्कों, शुरुआती बौद्ध स्तूपों और रेशम मार्ग की काफ़िलों से जुड़ चुकी थी।

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot of Yabghu speaking with traders at a roadside
panels.action: The Yabghu sits by a road, conferring with foreign merchants beside packed bundles and camels laden with silk, glass, and metalware.

dialogue.text: They controlled passes and river crossings. Every caravan that moved between India, Iran and the Han frontier felt the shadow of Yuezhi tolls and protection.

i18n.hi: वे पहाड़ी दर्रे और नदी–घाट नियंत्रित करते थे। इंडिया, ईरान और हान सीमा के बीच चलने वाला हर काफ़िला यूएझी की चुंगी और उसकी रखवाली की परछाईं महसूस करता था।

panels.shot: close-up on Yabghu’s weathered face, half in shadow
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu looks westward, face lined by years of migration, his eyes reflecting both past storms and the calm of secure pastures.

dialogue.text: Later scholars would debate their deeper origins, cautioning against simple labels. What is certain is the path they cut: from Gansu exile to Bactrian kingship.

i18n.hi: बाद के आलिम उनके गहरे मूल पर बहस करेंगे, सरल नामों से सावधान करेंगे। जो यक़ीन है वो है उनका सफर: गांसू के जला–वतन से बाक्ट्रिया के ताज तक।

panels.shot: epic wide shot, caravan now settled as scattered towns under dusk sky
panels.action: The Yabghu stands above a valley dotted with tents and new-built villages, smoke rising from hearths as the sun sets behind the Central Asian ranges.

dialogue.text: From this settled strength, the Guishuang clan would later forge the Kushan Empire, linking India to the Silk Road and shaping the flow of faiths, art and trade.

i18n.hi: इसी जम चुकी ताकत से गुइश्वांग कुल बाद में कुषाण साम्राज्य गढ़ेगा, इंडिया को रेशम मार्ग से जोड़ेगा और मज़हब, कला और व्यापार की धारा मोड़ देगा।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide, Yabghu on horseback silhouetted against stars
panels.action: Greater Yuezhi Yabghu sits quietly on horseback atop a ridge at night, the caravan resting below while a star-filled sky arches over the dark mountains.

dialogue.text: A people driven out of their homeland carried the seeds of a new world, turning forced migration into the foundation of empires and roads that would bind continents together.

i18n.hi: अपने वतन से निकाला गया यह कौम एक नई दुनिया के बीज साथ लाई, मजबूर हिजरत को उन साम्राज्यों और सड़कों की नींव बना दिया, जो पूरे महाद्वीपों को बाँध देंगी।

title_i18n.en: The Yuezhi Cross a Thousand Mountains

subtitle_i18n.en: From the Jade Gates to Bactria: An Exiled People on the Long Road West
subtitle_i18n.hi: जेड गेट से बाक्ट्रिया तक: लंबा पश्चिमी सफर पर निर्वासित लोग
